    // Create a bitmap and add some values that should form adjacent intervals
    rb := roaring64.New()

    for i := uint64(0); i <= 5; i++ {

    rb2.Add(11)
    
    result := roaring64.Or(rb, rb2)
    fmt.Printf("Union result cardinality: %d\n", result.GetCardinality())
}
